content: LiLi also uses a stack, called Inference Stack ( INLINEFORM0 ) to hold query and its state information for RL. LiLi always processes stack top ( INLINEFORM1 [top]). The clues from the user get stored in INLINEFORM2 on top of the query during strategy execution and processed first. Thus, the prediction model for INLINEFORM3 is learned before performing inference on query, transforming OKBC to a KBC problem. Table 1 shows the parameters of LiLi used in the following sections.
